music.name: Baby Jane
music.why: For a ticketed night out in Los Angeles on Dec 17.
music.summary: Baby Jane is scheduled for December 17, 2026; tickets are listed at $33.

music.name: Baby Jane
music.why: A rare chance to catch Baby Jane's genre-blurring house-pop set on her Winter Forever Tour, in a club-sized room rather than a theater.
music.summary: LED presents Baby Jane's Winter Forever Tour at EQ in San Diego, 21+, doors 10pm until 3am. Expect a house-meets-pop set from the LA-based producer and DJ.

music.name: Satin Jackets
music.why: A rare club-sized night with a nu-disco headliner, on a weekend run at a Venice room.
music.summary: Satin Jackets, the Swedish nu-disco and house producer, plays The Venice West in Venice. This is the second night of a two-night run, 12/17 and 12/18. Doors and show start at 10:30pm.

music.name: Bolo
music.why: A Saturday-night show in the historic Fox Theater, a short drive east of LA.
music.summary: Bolo plays the Fox Theater in Pomona on Saturday night, doors-to-late for an 18+ crowd.

music.name: Five Nights at Freddys Rave
music.why: Costume contest and themed drinks (Bite of 87, Purple Guy, The Glamrock) make this a playful, cosplay-friendly night out.
music.summary: A Five Nights at Freddy's-themed rave in a warehouse at The Compound by Dirt Dog, with prizes for the best themed outfits and cosplays and FNAF-inspired cocktails.

music.name: Rave Jesus - Rave Revival Fall Tour
music.why: A headline tour stop for Rave Jesus in a mid-size LA club room, built around the new Rave Revival material.
music.summary: Rave Jesus brings the Rave Revival Fall Tour to Teragram Ballroom for a Saturday-night show of high-energy electronic music.

music.name: Satin Jackets
music.why: Polished, sunlit nu-disco from the "Northern Lights" producer, in a Venice club on a Saturday night.
music.summary: German nu-disco and house producer Satin Jackets (Tim Bernhardt) plays The Venice West, 10:30pm to 2:30am, 21+.

music.name: Tommy Phillips + Cam Stockman at Spin Terrace
Svdden Death
music.why: A bass-music headliner known for crushing drops and a theatrical production, worth the trip south for riddim fans.
music.summary: Svdden Death brings his heavy dubstep and riddim set to Nova SD in San Diego, with doors opening late at night.

music.name: Gretchen Parlato with Gerald Clayton, Alan Hampton & Mark Guiliana
Jason Achilles
music.why: A low-key downtown dive-bar night with live music, easy to pair with dinner nearby.
music.summary: Jason Achilles plays The Redwood Bar and Grill in downtown LA, a Monday night set running from 8pm until 2am.

music.name: Ana Gasteyer: Sugar & Booze Holiday Spectacular
music.why: A comedic, boozy holiday show from the SNL alum in an intimate jazz-club room, with dinner and drinks at your table.
music.summary: Ana Gasteyer brings her holiday cabaret to Blue Note Los Angeles with two shows on Tuesday, Dec 15 (7 PM and 9:30 PM). Full bar and dinner menu; seating is first come, first served.

music.name: Kamran Shafii, Michael Masaru Flora, and Faith Rawson
music.why: Three distinct solo approaches to experimental electronic sound in one bill.
music.summary: Three sets of electronic mayhem: Kamran Shafii presents electroacoustic, psychoacoustics-informed work centered on anthropogenic sound; Michael Masaru Flora performs systems-driven, non-deterministic sound and installation-based approaches; Faith Rawson offers experimental compositions and live performance.

music.name: Libby Beard
music.why: A dive-bar night in historic downtown with a long evening window, so you can drop in whenever.
music.summary: Libby Beard plays a late-night set at The Redwood Bar And Grill in Downtown LA, 8 PM to 2 AM.

music.name: BlackNile
music.why: An intimate, small-room show from a self-produced artist.
music.summary: BlackNile performs his own self-written, produced and recorded material; he's a multi‑talented artist who has performed or worked with K Solo, Bizzy Bone, Dave Tollivier (of Men At Large) and Mel Man.

music.name: Syd: Beard Tour
music.why: Closing night of the tour in a landmark LA theater — the smooth, intimate R&B of the Internet's frontwoman in a room built for it.
music.summary: Syd brings her Beard Tour to the Art Deco Wiltern for the final night of its North American run, with doors and a 7pm start.

music.name: KCRW Presents Jane Lynch's A Swingin' Little Christmas
music.why: A theatrical, comedy-inflected approach to holiday standards with swinging jazz arrangements.
music.summary: Actor-singer Jane Lynch performs a loose, cabaret-style holiday set that mixes heartfelt takes on Christmas standards with zany, comedic moments, backed by a tight jazz combo.

music.name: Obscene (Goth / Industrial / EBM / Darkwave)
music.address: 351 S Broadway, Los Angeles, CA 90013, USA
music.why: Resident DJs plus on-site vendors create a focused local hub for EBM, industrial and darkwave.
music.summary: A monthly DJ night featuring resident DJs Industria Nova and Damascus Knives spinning EBM, industrial, goth and darkwave, with a dark, sexy dance-floor vibe often accompanied by vendors.

music.name: RANI's ROOM LA
music.why: A club-night pick for the week; the exact venue is still to be announced on the RA listing, so check it before heading out.
music.summary: RANI's ROOM LA is an evening music night in Mid-City Los Angeles on Thursday, Dec 17, listed on Resident Advisor, with doors around 8 PM.

music.name: Tell All Your Friends (Pop Punk & Emo Night)
music.why: Rooftop sing‑along energy that invites full crowd participation.
music.summary: A rooftop sing‑along night of emo and pop‑punk with alt‑rock and electropop elements, featuring VALLEYGHOUL, SULKFORM and VICTORIA VINYL — black eyeliner and angst highly encouraged.

music.name: Bou, Airglo, Nightstalker, Skanka
music.why: Main-room EDM production and big-room DJ sets deliver peak club energy.
music.summary: A high-energy EDM club night led by Bou with support from Airglo, Nightstalker and Skanka, featuring dancefloor-focused DJ sets and big-room electronic grooves.

music.name: Bu Tea & Techno
music.address: 2715 S Main St, Los Angeles 90007, USA
music.why: Tea service during ambient‑into‑techno sets creates a relaxed, intimate club vibe.
music.summary: A tea‑house‑turned‑party that moves from ambient into driving techno, with loose‑leaf tea available at the bar and an intimate sound system that keeps the room easy to talk in or to dance. Lineups are posted on the venue’s Instagram the day of.

music.name: Daft Punk Night
music.address: 1652 North Cherokee Avenue, Los Angeles, CA 90028
music.why: A full-catalog tribute format that mixes classic duo material with French-touch and nu-disco club favorites.
music.summary: A tribute night built around Daft Punk’s catalog, spinning hits, deep cuts, live versions and remixes alongside French-touch and nu-disco dancefloor fare for nonstop, feel-good grooves.

music.name: Das Bunker: History Of Industrial: Assemblage 23, Dark Chisme, Anarchotech
music.why: A decades-running industrial/goth party that helped define and sustain the scene.
music.summary: A long-running industrial/goth multi-room dance night that champions brutalist club music and electronic body music, with high-energy, sweat-drenched floors where goth kids, aging metalheads and younger crowds converge. Founded in 1996, the party has become a defining, archival force in the local industrial underground.

music.name: Electric Ave
music.address: 3040 W SUNSET BLVD, LOS ANGELES, CA 90026
music.why: Showcases underground DJs and creates performance opportunities via a community arts nonprofit.
music.summary: An EMX/Community Arts & Festivals–presented dance night spotlighting underground electronic DJ sets, with club-focused house, deep house, tech house and techno to keep the floor moving.

music.name: Generacion Suicida
music.why: A promoter-curated multi-band bill presented by In Fuzz We Trust.
music.summary: Presented by In Fuzz We Trust, Generacion Suicida headlines a multi-band live bill at The Redwood Bar And Grill.

music.name: Halloween Town Vs Christmas Town: Xvirad, Flowr, Xoxo, Rave God, Deb Skellington
music.why: Costumes or Christmas wear get a discount at the door, and entry is free before 11:30pm with RSVP.
music.summary: Flowr Productions mashes up Nightmare Before Christmas themes in one rave: a Halloween Town vs Christmas Town night with a runway show, vendors and food and drinks.

music.name: KCRW Presents Jane Lynch's A Swingin' Little Christmas
music.why: A swingy holiday show that mixes comic timing with classic seasonal songs.
music.summary: A Swingin' Little Christmas is a holiday set built around swing-flavored takes on seasonal favorites, blending musical standards with comedy and stage banter. In an intimate jazz-club format the performance reads more like a conversational, comedic-crooner show than a formal recital.

music.name: Marten Horger w/ DJ Susan,Gold Lemonade, Dayze
music.why: Hørger's warm, groove-forward sets and a strong local undercard make this a pick for dancefloor-first crowds.
music.summary: Marten Hørger headlines Academy LA with special guest DJ Susan plus Gold Lemonade and Dayze — a Friday night of house and techno on Hollywood Blvd.

music.name: Project X
music.why: A movie-inspired house-party spectacle that recreates the film’s chaotic, nostalgic energy on the dancefloor.
music.summary: Club Decades stages a Project X–themed dance party that channels the chaos, nostalgia and high-energy house‑party vibe of the film, essentially staging a house-party fantasy on a club dancefloor.

music.name: Tmple
music.address: 1601 North Cahuenga Boulevard, Los Angeles, California 90028
music.why: Groove-first, dancefloor-focused house rather than drop-driven EDM.
music.summary: Tmple headlines a house music night that favors groove-first, dancefloor-ready sets over festival-style drops. The event flyer also shows the line "Possibly Sunny," though it's unclear whether that denotes a co-bill or a party name.

music.name: Wide Awake
music.why: Two-stage format that spots hard dance and dubstep with immersive production.
music.summary: A multi-stage underground dance night mixing hard dance, techno, and dubstep across two stages, backed by heavy production and a stacked DJ lineup. The event also includes a vendor market and promises high-energy late-night beats.

music.name: WORK presents: 999999999 [4 HR Set]. JIA, & Trovarsi [LIVE]
music.why: An unusually long, four-hour DJ set paired with a live electronic performance and immersive lighting.
music.summary: WORK presents an extended four-hour set from 999999999 alongside performances by JIA and Trovarsi (live), accompanied by a light installation from Ausgang Studio; the exact location is emailed to ticket holders about two hours before the event.

music.name: Atara Ara
music.why: High-energy sets that fuse J‑rock flair and singalong pop‑punk with anime covers.
music.summary: Atara Ara is a four-piece rock band that blends modern alternative with Japanese rock, delivering energetic, pop-punk–tinged songs and anime‑influenced visuals; their live sets mix original material with anime covers.
music.price: $10 at the door, all ages welcome

music.name: Crank Sturgeon, Misery Ritual, Ritual Chair Christian Lovers, Hexpressionist, Hate Eradicator
music.why: Misery Ritual’s first live appearance in over six years.
music.summary: A night of SoCal-based harsh noise and power electronics, with Crank Sturgeon’s dada-infused electro-acoustic clangor and big cardboard fishhead theatrics. The lineup also features Misery Ritual returning to live performance after six years, plus harsh noisecore and experimental sets from Christian Lovers, Ritual Chair, Hexpressionist, and the antifascist power-electronics project Hate Eradicator.

music.name: Dub Meeting Feat. Imperial Sound Army & Yungg Trip
music.why: Immersive, heavyweight dub on custom dual stereo stacks with an international sound crew.
music.summary: Dub Siren HiFi brings Imperial Sound Army from Italy to a secret downtown warehouse for a night of heavyweight roots and dub played through both stacks of their custom-built stereo sound system. Yungg Trip joins Imperial Sound Army alongside Mello Banton, Rootsman, Ryo Vibes and the Dub Siren HiFi crew, with soundsdistilled taking the closing set into jungle; the warehouse address will be released the day of the event.

music.name: DUBLAB presents: COMMONTHREAD with Eva Noxious
music.why: A cross-genre bill that blends classic hip‑hop and G‑funk with adventurous house, techno and crate-digging vinyl sets.
music.summary: The bill pairs Eva Noxious's independent hip-hop—drawing on classic hip-hop and G-funk—with Santiago Salazar's expansive, soulful DJ sets that move through Latin house, hi‑tech jazz, Detroit techno, electro and ghetto tech. Also featured are three6sashia, an Oakland vinyl DJ who folds jazz and international sounds into groove-driven sets, and LA-based producer/DJ Yessi, whose practice spans production, composition and sound design.

Re:frame: nimino
music.why: re:frame outfits a purpose-built soundstage to blend nightclub intimacy with concert-scale production.
music.summary: Part of Framework’s re:frame Season 2, nimino appears for an electronic-music night at Reframe Studios indoors — a state-of-the-art Atwater Village soundstage created to sit between the intimacy of a nightclub and the scale of a concert venue.

sports.name: DTLA Running Group
sports.venue: The Bloc (7th St between Flower and Hope)
sports.why: An easy way to meet other runners and see downtown on foot after work.
sports.summary: Weekly evening group run from The Bloc in downtown LA, organized through the DTLA Running Group Strava club.

sports.name: Griffith Park Hike to Vista View Point- Moderate
sports.venue: Griffith Park Merry Go Round Lot 2, Merry Go Round Lot Two
sports.address: Merry Go Round Lot Two, LOS ANGELES, CA
sports.why: Uses a back-route through Beacon and Fern Canyon for viewpoint access and fewer crowds.
sports.summary: A moderate 4.5-mile hike with about 1,200 ft of elevation gain out to Vista View Point, following the Lower Beacon to Coolidge to Upper Beacon trails and returning via Fern Canyon; the walk is planned to take roughly two hours at a steady, non-competitive pace.

sports.name: Queer Crush @ Sender One WW
sports.venue: Sender One Climbing - Westwood, 10887 Lindbrook Dr
sports.why: Focuses on community-building with a welcoming intro circle for queer climbers of any experience.
sports.summary: An all-level queer climbing meetup that mixes social climbing with an intro circle to help attendees connect and get oriented; newcomers and experienced climbers alike are welcome.

sports.name: Sierra Club Griffith Park Tuesday Evening Hikes
sports.why: Simultaneous, level-based conditioning hikes led by trained Sierra Club leaders.
sports.summary: An evening of Sierra Club–led hikes offering simultaneous routes across multiple conditioning levels (1–6); hikes run about two hours over hilly, sometimes steep and uneven terrain. These group hikes draw dozens of participants and are paced by trained leaders so hikers can pick the challenge that fits them.

sports.name: Tuesday Womens Soccer - Stoner Park 7:15 PM
sports.venue: Grassy Area, Southeast Corner of Stoner Park (Corner of Stoner Ave/ Missouri Ave), FREE PARKING, 1854 Stoner Ave.
sports.why: Run via a Meetup with shared gear and coordinated Parks & Rec registration to fund field upkeep.
sports.summary: A weekly women's recreational soccer pickup organized by local volunteers; players are asked to RSVP and contribute small annual Meetup and Parks & Rec class fees that cover shared equipment, goals and field maintenance, with registration available online or in person.

sports.name: DTLA Running Group
sports.venue: The Bloc (7th St between Flower and Hope)
sports.why: Inclusive, no‑cost group run welcoming every pace and age.
sports.summary: A free community run that explores the heart of Downtown Los Angeles — open to all paces and ages and held regularly as a weekly group run.

sports.name: Sierra Club Griffith Park Thursday Evening Hikes
sports.why: Simultaneous, multi-level evening hikes led by trained leaders.
sports.summary: A Sierra Club group runs simultaneous evening hikes across multiple difficulty levels (1–6), led by trained leaders; hikes last about two hours and include hilly, sometimes steep and uneven terrain. Newcomers are encouraged to stick to lower levels and follow the leader's pace.

sports.name: FRIDAY--Easy Night walk around Silverlake
sports.venue: Silver Lake Recreation Center, 1850 W Silver Lake Dr
sports.address: 1850 W Silver Lake Dr, Los Angeles, CA
sports.why: Short, accessible lake loop with a casual post-walk oyster bar meetup.
sports.summary: A mostly easy 2.2-mile round-trip evening walk around Silver Lake, roughly an hour long with a short uphill; some participants head to a nearby oyster bar afterward.

sports.name: 2026 Pickleball Lovers!! Join Our Weekend "Social Dinkers" Pickleball Community!
sports.venue: 6333 W 3rd St, Los Angeles, CA 90036, 6333 W 3rd St, Los Angeles, CA 90036
sports.address: 6333 W 3rd St, Los Angeles, CA 90036, Los Angeles, Ca
sports.why: Rotating-partner, social-first format with beginner-friendly guides and post-game meetups.
sports.summary: A relaxed, beginner-friendly pickleball mixer that uses short, easygoing matches and rotating partners to help people meet; friendly players and guides are on hand to show newcomers the basics. Play is followed by a nearby post-game social, and specific court locations are shared with confirmed attendees rather than publicized in advance.
